info.name: DoCoNEXT Finder
info.summary: Starter template for DoCoNEXT Nextcloud apps
info.description:
A minimal, working Nextcloud app that embodies the DoCoNEXT conventions: three-layer backend (Controller → Service → Mapper), attribute-based routing, Vue 3 + TypeScript frontend, configurable display name, admin/personal settings, migrations, l10n, quality gates, CI, and the standardized deploy.sh.
Use scripts/init-app.sh to stamp out a new app from this template.
info.author: DoCoNEXT
